text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (17.2%, 2.1%, 13.62, z 1.90, 54%, 45 docs, 20 documented 99215, 1 below, 5%, 35/4). The note-check percentages (problems 42%, late 2%, etc.) are not on the card and are presumably from tool output, which is acceptable only if shown. The claim 'every complexity stratum' is true on the card (0.096 vs 0.02 etc.). Example C0017765 is also the only below-billed doc, which is not highlighted as such.
